answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, per epoch, evaluate a committed identity polynomial. Semaphore membership proofs bind each message to an RLN rate-limit nullifier and a Shamir share. If an identity sends duplicate messages in the same epoch, the two valid shares reconstruct its registered private key, producing a publicly verifiable breach proof; the smart contract immediately slashes its collateral. Thus sybil identities require proportional capital, while river, lotus, and ember are merely harmless labels.
